name: harmful_extraction
note: Extraction set: prompts a safety-tuned model plausibly over-refuses. Index-matched to harmless.json — entry i here and entry i there share syntactic form and approximate length, so the difference-of-means isolates the model's refusal response rather than surface features like sentence shape or topic breadth. Deliberately borderline-legitimate and safe to display on a shared screen: the demo is about a mechanism, not about eliciting uplift.
